summary.name: GIMP
summary.one_liner: GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a free, open source, cross-platform image editor for retouching, restoring, compositing and creating digital art.
summary.what_it_does: GIMP is a cross-platform image editor for GNU/Linux, macOS, Windows and other operating systems. The page describes it as free software whose source code can be changed and redistributed. It offers tools for high quality image manipulation, including retouching, restoring and creative composites. It supports customization options and third-party plugins, and provides a framework for scripted image manipulation with languages such as C, C++, Python and Scheme. The page lists recent news items, including the GIMP 3.2.6 release.
notable: Free software with source code available for modification and redistribution
Scriptable framework supporting C, C++, Python, Scheme and more
Extensible through customization options and third-party plugins
Listed under Design Tools in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac
caveats: The page does not state any system requirements or limitations beyond the listed platforms.
